The Quebec Land Transport Repository (RQTT) web service is under preparation and will be available later. Please note that the web service under the name [AQRéseau+] (https://www.donneesquebec.ca/recherche/dataset/adresses-quebec/resource/5c157b6b-b48a-407e-b9dd-eab45ee4809c) remains available until the RQTT web service is operational.

The Quebec Land Transport Reference System (RQTT) is a common geographic reference across Quebec. 

This product offers an integrated mapping of the main transport networks, in particular multi-use roads, the Quebec Road Network Reference System (RQRR) as well as that of access roads to territories and those of the network of the Société des de plein air du Québec (Sépaq). It also includes additional data related to the various components of transport.

The main components are as follows:

* Road network 

 * RQRR road network

 * Multipurpose paths 

 * Access roads to territories 

 * Sépaq: national park networks and institutions 

* Green Route bike path 

* Railways 

* Level crossings 

* Air transport 

* Route Blanche snowmobile trails 

* Snowmobile trails from the Federation of Quebec Snowmobile Clubs 

* Quad trails from the Quebec Federation of Quad Clubs and Quebec Federation of Off-Road Motorcycles 

The Quebec Land Transport Framework is based on the contribution of several partners and collaborators.

More details on the organizations involved are available in the [RQTT User Guide.] (https://diffusion.mern.gouv.qc.ca/diffusion/RGQ/Vectoriel/Theme/Local/RQTT/Document/Guide_d_utilisation_RQTT.pdf)
